card_box_name: CET6 听力 Trial 1033：细节排除（干扰项辨析）

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，了解本节训练重点：干扰项排除（绝对化 / 偷换对象 / 无中生有）。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，了解本节训练重点：干扰项排除（绝对化 / 偷换对象 / 无中生有）。

back_content.text: 结论：干扰项三类：①绝对化（always/never）②偷换对象（张冠李戴）③无中生有（音频未提及）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The research center has made significant progress in three key areas: renewable energy, water purification, and sustainable agriculture, though budget constraints remain a challenge.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：三个研究领域（renewable energy / water purification / sustainable agriculture）+ 一个障碍（budget constraints）。② 核心规律：干扰项制造方式：绝对化（"all areas are successful"）、偷换（"water pollution"代替"water purification"）、无中生有（"received government award"音频未提及）。③ 验证与迁移：逐项验证：选项与音频是否字面对应，对应了是否语义一致，语义一致了是否逻辑合理。
tips: 绝对化干扰项：all / every / never / always = 过度概括，容易排除。
偷换对象：近义词替换但对象不同（purification→pollution），需要精确匹配。

audio.transcript: The research center has made significant progress in three key areas: renewable energy, water purification, and sustainable agriculture, though budget constraints remain a challenge.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再识别并排除干扰项，选出与音频一致的正确选项。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再识别并排除干扰项，选出与音频一致的正确选项。

back_content.text: 结论：正确答案C：研究员在偏远地区观察了3个月；A/B/D均为干扰项（偷换/绝对化/无中生有）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The field researcher spent three months observing wildlife in a remote mountain region, documenting over two hundred species and recording their seasonal migration patterns.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：three months / remote mountain region / over two hundred species / seasonal migration = 四个核心信息点。② 干扰项分析：A（twoyears = 偷换时间）；B（all species = 绝对化）；D（received a research grant = 无中生有）。③ 验证与迁移：正确答案必须与音频中的每个细节（时间/地点/数量/行为）完全对应。
tips: 先听数字和时间，这是干扰项最常偷换的信息（3 months vs 3 years）。
无中生有干扰项：听完音频后问"这在音频里有提到吗？"没有=无中生有。

audio.transcript: The field researcher spent three months observing wildlife in a remote mountain region, documenting over two hundred species and recording their seasonal migration patterns.

options.text: The researcher spent two years in the field.
All species in the region were successfully documented.
The researcher documented over two hundred species in three months.
The researcher received a grant for the wildlife study.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再在规定时间内指出干扰项类型及正确信息。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再在规定时间内指出干扰项类型及正确信息。

back_content.text: 结论：干扰项："free for all students"=绝对化（实为需申请）；正确信息：低收入学生可申请补贴。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The university has introduced a subsidized meal program to support students from low-income backgrounds, though students must apply and provide proof of financial need.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：subsidized（补贴非免费）/ low-income backgrounds（特定群体非所有学生）/ must apply and provide proof（需要申请+证明，非自动获得）。② 干扰项类型分析："free for all students" = 绝对化+偷换对象（subsidized≠free，all≠low-income）。③ 验证与迁移：复述时先指出干扰项类型（绝对化），再说正确信息（低收入学生申请补贴）。
tips: free ≠ subsidized（补贴不是免费，仍需部分付费）；是精确词汇的偷换。
all students vs students from low-income backgrounds = 范围扩大是绝对化干扰项的常见形式。

audio.transcript: The university has introduced a subsidized meal program to support students from low-income backgrounds, though students must apply and provide proof of financial need.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再进行影子跟读，注意限定词（only / some / most / all）的重读。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再进行影子跟读，注意限定词（only / some / most / all）的重读。

back_content.text: 结论：完成跟读，注意限定词重读（only/some区分绝对化干扰项的关键词）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Only some of the participants reported significant improvement, while the majority experienced moderate benefits, and a small number showed no measurable change at all.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：only some（部分）/ the majority（多数但非全部）/ a small number（少数）/ no measurable change（无变化）= 四种结果分布，无绝对化。② 核心规律：跟读时重读量化限定词（only/some/majority/small/no），这些词是排除绝对化干扰项的关键信号。③ 验证与迁移：跟读后能准确复述数量分布（部分/多数/少数），是本卡成功标准。
tips: only some / a few / most = 表示程度的量化词，考题中是排除"all"类干扰项的关键。
跟读时重读这些量化词，养成在听力中捕捉数量信息的习惯。

audio.transcript: Only some of the participants reported significant improvement, while the majority experienced moderate benefits, and a small number showed no measurable change at all.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再选出与音频内容一致的选项（注意排除三类干扰项）。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再选出与音频内容一致的选项（注意排除三类干扰项）。

back_content.text: 结论：正确选项B：部分员工接受了培训；A=绝对化，C=偷换对象，D=无中生有。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The company provided cybersecurity training to selected employees in the IT and finance departments, focusing on phishing detection and password management.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：selected employees（不是所有人）/ IT and finance（两个部门非全公司）/ phishing + password（两个具体主题）。② 干扰项分析：A（"all employees" = 绝对化）；C（"HR department" = 偷换对象/部门）；D（"external consultants" = 无中生有）。③ 验证与迁移：本题综合考察三类干扰项识别；答题策略：先排除绝对化（all）→排除偷换（HR）→排除无中生有（consultants）→确认B。
tips: 三步排除法：绝对化→偷换对象→无中生有，剩下的就是正确答案。
selected / certain / some = 限定范围词，对应排除"all / every"类选项。

audio.transcript: The company provided cybersecurity training to selected employees in the IT and finance departments, focusing on phishing detection and password management.

options.text: Selected employees in IT and finance received cybersecurity training.
The HR department organized the cybersecurity training.
External consultants were hired to conduct the training.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再识别该中心在国际上最受关注的研究领域。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再识别该中心在国际上最受关注的研究领域。

back_content.text: 结论：最受国际关注的领域：computational neuroscience（不是 materials science 也不是 molecular biology）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The research center has made significant strides in three distinct areas: materials science, molecular biology, and computational neuroscience. Of these, the work in computational neuroscience has attracted the most international attention.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："Of these" = 从已列举的三项中作比较排除；"most...attention" = 最高级比较，是排他性的。② 核心规律：CET6 干扰项：题目含多个并列项，但只有最高级/特定限定词指向的那个是答案，其余是干扰。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：materials science / molecular biology（均被提及但不是 "most international attention"）；答案：computational neuroscience。
tips: most/least + 形容词 = 最高级唯一指向，其他选项是干扰，即使被提及也不符合最高等级限制。
"Of these" = 从中选一，标志排除法开始，即将指出唯一答案。

audio.transcript: The research center has made significant strides in three distinct areas: materials science, molecular biology, and computational neuroscience. Of these, the work in computational neuroscience has attracted the most international attention.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再识别安全隐患的准确位置。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再识别安全隐患的准确位置。

back_content.text: 结论：安全隐患准确位置：sections B and C 的通风系统（不是 eastern wing）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The inspector's report noted that the facility met safety standards in most respects. However, concerns were raised specifically about the ventilation system in sections B and C, not the eastern wing as previously reported.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："specifically about" = 明确限定；"not the eastern wing as previously reported" = 直接否定干扰项。② 核心规律：CET6 否定排除："not X" + "but Y" = Y 是答案，X 是干扰项，尤其 "not...as previously reported" = 刻意纠正旧信息。③ 验证与迁移：答案：sections B and C（通风系统）；干扰项：eastern wing（被明确否定）。
tips: not X but Y = 明确排除干扰，Y 是实际答案；"not...as previously..." = 纠正型干扰排除。
听力题中出现 "not" + 位置/人名/数字 = 该信息被否定，选同类中未否定的。

audio.transcript: The inspector's report noted that the facility met safety standards in most respects. However, concerns were raised specifically about the ventilation system in sections B and C, not the eastern wing as previously reported.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断候选人在辩论中未涉及的议题。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断候选人在辩论中未涉及的议题。

back_content.text: 结论：未涉及的议题：tax policy changes（第三项）；仅详细谈了 healthcare reform 和 infrastructure investment。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The candidate's campaign promises centered on three issues: healthcare reform, infrastructure investment, and tax policy changes. During the debate, she spoke at length about the first two, but did not address the third.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："but did not address the third" = 直接说明第三项被跳过；the third = tax policy changes（按顺序推断）。② 核心规律：CET6 顺序干扰：列举三项后说明某项未被提及，需记清顺序（第一/二/三项）。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：healthcare/infrastructure（均被提及）；答案：the third = tax policy。
tips: first/second/third + "did not address/mention" = 标准顺序排除题，记住序号和对应项目。
spoke at length about = 详细讲了，是 "确实提到" 的标志，与答案相反方向。

audio.transcript: The candidate's campaign promises centered on three issues: healthcare reform, infrastructure investment, and tax policy changes. During the debate, she spoke at length about the first two, but did not address the third.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断项目延误的最主要因素。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断项目延误的最主要因素。

back_content.text: 结论：最主要因素：regulatory changes（监管变化）；supply chain 和 staffing 也被提及但不是 by far the most significant。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Several factors contributed to the project delay, including supply chain disruptions, staffing shortages, and unexpected regulatory changes. According to the project manager, the regulatory changes were by far the most significant.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："by far the most significant" = 压倒性的最高级，排他性指向；"according to" = 引用权威判断。② 核心规律：CET6 因果干扰排除：多因素题中，"by far the most" / "primarily" = 唯一最重要答案，其余均是干扰。③ 验证与迁移：答案：regulatory changes；干扰项：supply chain disruptions + staffing shortages（被提及但被排出最高级）。
tips: by far + most = 压倒性最高级，其余选项无论多合理都是干扰。
several factors + one is most important = CET6 因果类典型结构，答案锁定最重要那项。

options.text: Staffing shortages were the primary cause of the delay.
Regulatory changes were the most significant factor.
Supply chain disruptions caused the most damage.
All three factors contributed equally to the delay.

audio.transcript: Several factors contributed to the project delay, including supply chain disruptions, staffing shortages, and unexpected regulatory changes. According to the project manager, the regulatory changes were by far the most significant.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断奖学金发放的优先标准，并识别被排除的干扰标准。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断奖学金发放的优先标准，并识别被排除的干扰标准。

back_content.text: 结论：优先标准：highest financial need（最高经济需求）；被排除的干扰：academic merit alone（单纯学术成绩不是优先标准）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The university's financial aid office confirmed that scholarships are available to students from all income levels, but priority is given to those demonstrating the highest financial need, not academic merit alone.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："but priority is given to" = 限定优先标准；"not academic merit alone" = 直接排除干扰项。② 核心规律：CET6 Not A alone + but B = A 是干扰项，B 才是答案；not X alone = X 是次要或部分因素，不是主要判断依据。③ 验证与迁移：答案：financial need is the primary criterion；academic performance is NOT the decisive factor。
tips: not A alone = A 不是唯一/主要决定因素，排除 A 的干扰；正面答案在 but 之后。
priority is given to = 语气强度向 but 之后的内容聚焦，该短语后接真正答案标准。

audio.transcript: The university's financial aid office confirmed that scholarships are available to students from all income levels, but priority is given to those demonstrating the highest financial need, not academic merit alone.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断最新研究的新增内容及其初步结论。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断最新研究的新增内容及其初步结论。

back_content.text: 结论：新增内容：纳入46-70岁患者；初步结论：这个年龄段的结果看起来有希望（promising）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：While the early clinical trials tested the drug on patients aged 18 to 45, the latest study extended the cohort to include patients aged 46 to 70. The preliminary results for this older group appear promising.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："While... early trials" = 背景信息（干扰项），"latest study extended" = 更新内容（答案所在）。② 核心规律：CET6 新旧信息干扰：while/previously/earlier = 旧信息（干扰），latest/new/extended = 当前，答案在新信息部分。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：18-45（旧研究范围）；答案：46-70（新增范围）+ promising results（初步结论）。
tips: while/previously + old info → latest/new/current + new info = 新信息是答案，旧信息是干扰。
the preliminary results appear promising = 初步结论，但 preliminary = 尚待确认，用词精确。

audio.transcript: While the early clinical trials tested the drug on patients aged 18 to 45, the latest study extended the cohort to include patients aged 46 to 70. The preliminary results for this older group appear promising.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断本次论文的写作重点，并识别被排除的内容。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断本次论文的写作重点，并识别被排除的内容。

back_content.text: 结论：写作重点：economic implications；被排除（干扰项）：political origins + social outcomes（留待下一模块）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The professor emphasized that students should focus their essay on the economic implications of the policy, not on its political origins or its social outcomes, which will be covered in the next module.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："should focus on" = 指令性动词，明确答案；"not on" = 直接排除干扰项。② 核心规律：CET6 指令性干扰排除：focus on X, not Y = X 是答案，Y 是干扰；which will be covered later = 延迟信息，不是当前答案。③ 验证与迁移：答案：economic implications；干扰（二选一）：political origins / social outcomes（均被 not on 排除为本次内容）。
tips: focus on X / concentrate on X = 正向指令，X 是重点任务。
not on Y / excluding Z = 排除词，Y/Z 是干扰项；which will be covered later = 明确说明是延迟内容。

audio.transcript: The professor emphasized that students should focus their essay on the economic implications of the policy, not on its political origins or its social outcomes, which will be covered in the next module.
